ios.desc:
Say goodbye to the guesswork. Other apps only tell you what you did last time – Now just pick your weight and Ironside tells you precisely what you're capable of. Simply dial the weight up or down until the reps match your target.

SWITCH IN SECONDS
Already tracking in Strong, Hevy, or JEFIT? Import your full history and pick up right where you left off.

WORK SMARTER
Ironside shows insights that other apps can’t:
• Plateau detection
• Momentum tracking
• Recovery snapshot
• Goal and progress tracking
• Fully incorporated AI Coach (Bring your own API Key)

ALL THE GOOD STUFF
• 1RM, Plate loading, RPE-to-%, Warmup and Calorie calculators all included
• Unlimited templates and custom exercises
• Max Weight, Reps, Volume and Estimated 1RM trackers
• Sync your workouts and body measurements with Apple Health
• Rest Timers on your lock screen
• Exercise library with over 150+ exercises and counting
• Have fun while doing it: Level up your Power Rank, collect Badges, share your workouts and enjoy your monthly Wrapped!

LOCAL-FIRST
All your data stays on your device. No account required. No cloud sync. Export everything at any time.

ONE PRICE. EVERYTHING INCLUDED. NO SUBSCRIPTION.
Your first 10 workouts are completely free. Just one small purchase to unlock Ironside forever.

quotes.text:
I'm Mitch, a solo dev in New Zealand. I built Ironside because I was tired of workout trackers turning basic logging, PR tracking, basic analysis into $10-15/month subscriptions.

It's local-first by design: no account, no cloud sync, everything stays on-device, export to CSV anytime. If you're already on Strong, Hevy, FitNotes, or JEFIT, you can import everything in one step from a CSV file.

Instead of bundling a subscription AI coach, I made it a BYOK model so you can add your own Claude, ChatGPT, or Gemini API key since you're already paying for that!

Every feature is included (PR tracking, plateau detection, recovery balance, templates, HealthKit sync, widgets) for a small one-time $6.99 NZD IAP — you get the first 10 workouts free to try out, making it a free App to download which should get much more traction that way.

Built with Next.js 15, Capacitor, TypeScript and Tailwind. Happy to go into the weeds on any of it. It's iOS only right now but with Capacitor it shouldn't be too long now until I can publish to the PlayStore as well!

Site - https://ironsideapp.com
App Store - https://apps.apple.com/nz/app/ironside-workout-tracker/id6761750555 or any region, it's global

Would really like some feedback, especially from anyone who's had a go with local-first mobile data or BYOK AI themselves.
